The canonical gzip JSON is `native_campaign_ai_perception_policy_tu15.json.gz`,
350,204 bytes; SHA256
`9158b45ea075527693890717e4a2a7f3c7a9b12647c64d9a7e5d73d06f146cda`.
It contains 753 complete unchanged physical original calls and 131 read-failure
prefixes. All 331 new-owner sites and all 71 sites of the called existing
character selectors execute. Complete physical banks are interned by SHA256;
expected output banks are not derived from read or write logs.

Coverage includes inherited character blocks, fresh authored order/action
selection for each ancestor, signed negative block variants, target/mode
perception variants, all 256 signed override-byte values, primary and secondary
unit selection, signed seat indices, actual vehicle tag and primary-unit flag
policy, matching inherited vehicle blocks, query/extension wrapped-null gates,
and first matching player-owned child selection. The queries consume actual
declared datums, tables, body records and tag blocks. No character-policy,
vehicle, target or player result is supplied.

The original child-player output is a disjoint caller-private optional DWORD.
Completed nonnull-output calls compare that output to the typed native pair;
null-output calls compare the original player result. Failure prefixes qualify
the actual lazy retained reads and unchanged persistent banks; they do not
claim transport of partially written private original output at a rejected
read. No runtime source-stack memory is synthesized. Retained-output aliases
are outside this private caller profile.

These owners perform no floating-point arithmetic. The original preserves its
declared source controls/status across complete calls and rejected reads, and
the native calls preserve real ambient host controls and live x87 values.
The physical oracle executes unchanged original instructions offline only.
It never patches a branch, supplies a callee return or resumes a stopped prefix.
